mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID AS "USER_ID", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "USER_NAME", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS "PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS "profileImagePath", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.SHOW_EMAIL, 'Y') = 'Y' THEN NVL(wp.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) ELSE NULL END AS "EMAIL", wm.WS_ROLE AS "WS_ROLE", wp.POSITION_NAME AS "WS_POSITION" FROM WS_MEMBERS wm JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = wm.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES wp ON wp.WS_ID = wm.WS_ID AND wp.USER_ID = wm.USER_ID WHERE wm.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND pm.USER_ID = wm.USER_ID ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN wm.WS_ROLE IN ('OWNER', 'LEADER') THEN 1 WHEN wm.WS_ROLE = 'ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, "USER_NAME" ASC

SELECT pm.USER_ID, CASE WHEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "USER_NAME", CASE WHEN NVL(wp.SHOW_EMAIL, 'Y') = 'Y' THEN NVL(wp.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) ELSE NULL END AS "EMAIL", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN (wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL OR wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' AND NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') AND NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, '#')) THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END ELSE CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'IMAGE' THEN u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END END AS "PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN (wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL OR wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' AND NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') AND NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, '#')) THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END ELSE CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'IMAGE' THEN u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END END AS "profileImagePath", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH END AS "PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_SCALE, 1) ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, 1) END AS "PROFILE_CROP_SCALE", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_X, 0) ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, 0) END AS "PROFILE_CROP_X", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_CROP_Y, 0) ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, 0) END AS "PROFILE_CROP_Y", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN (wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL OR wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' AND NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') AND NVL(wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, '#')) THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END ELSE UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) END AS "PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE", CASE WHEN pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') ELSE 'Y' END AS "USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE", wp.POSITION_NAME AS "WS_POSITION", pm.PROJ_ROLE, pm.PROJ_POSITION AS "PROJ_POSITION", TO_CHAR(pm.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "PROJ_JOINED_AT", TO_CHAR(wm.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "WS_JOINED_AT" FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm JOIN PROJECTS pr ON pr.PROJ_ID = pm.PROJ_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID = pr.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES wp ON wp.WS_ID = pr.WS_ID AND wp.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = #{projId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN pm.USER_ID = pr.LEADER_ID THEN 1 WHEN pm.PROJ_ROLE = 'ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, "USER_NAME" ASC
SELECT PROJ_ID, PROJ_NAME, WS_ID FROM PROJECTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projId", p.PROJ_NAME AS "projName", p.WS_ID AS "wsId", TO_CHAR(pd.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate", TO_CHAR(pd.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate" FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJ_ID, MIN(START_DT) AS START_DT, MAX(END_DT) AS END_DT FROM EVENTS WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EVENT_TYPE = 'PROJECT_PERIOD' GROUP BY PROJ_ID ) pd ON pd.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND (pd.END_DT IS NULL OR TRUNC(pd.END_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN pd.START_DT ELSE pd.END_DT END ASC NULLS LAST, p.PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projId", p.PROJ_NAME AS "projName", p.WS_ID AS "wsId", TO_CHAR(pd.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate", TO_CHAR(pd.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate" FROM PROJECTS p JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID = p.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJ_ID, MIN(START_DT) AS START_DT, MAX(END_DT) AS END_DT FROM EVENTS WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EVENT_TYPE = 'PROJECT_PERIOD' GROUP BY PROJ_ID ) pd ON pd.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE p.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND (pd.END_DT IS NULL OR TRUNC(pd.END_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ORDER BY p.WS_ID DESC, CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN pd.START_DT ELSE pd.END_DT END ASC NULLS LAST, p.PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projId", p.PROJ_NAME AS "projName", p.WS_ID AS "wsId", NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) AS "projScope", TO_CHAR(pd.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate", TO_CHAR(pd.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate" FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJ_ID, MIN(START_DT) AS START_DT, MAX(END_DT) AS END_DT FROM EVENTS WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EVENT_TYPE = 'PROJECT_PERIOD' GROUP BY PROJ_ID ) pd ON pd.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) = 'PERSONAL' AND NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND (pd.END_DT IS NULL OR TRUNC(pd.END_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND ( p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId} ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN pd.START_DT ELSE pd.END_DT END ASC NULLS LAST, p.PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "PROJ_ID", p.WS_ID AS "WS_ID", p.PROJ_NAME AS "PROJ_NAME", p.PROJ_DESC AS "PROJ_DESC", p.PROJ_TYPE AS "PROJ_TYPE", p.PROJ_CATEGORY AS "PROJ_CATEGORY", NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') AS "DELETE_STATUS", TO_CHAR(p.DELETE_DEADLINE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "DELETE_DEADLINE_DATE", p.LEADER_ID AS "LEADER_ID", CASE WHEN NVL(leader_wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(leader_wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "LEADER_NAME", TO_CHAR(pd.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(pd.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN pd.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.END_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END AS "PROJECT_STATUS", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID) AS "MEMBER_COUNT", ( SELECT LISTAGG( CASE WHEN NVL(member_wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(member_wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u2.USER_NAME) ELSE u2.USER_NAME END, ', ' ) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN pm2.USER_ID = p.LEADER_ID THEN 1 WHEN pm2.PROJ_ROLE = 'ADMIN' THEN 2 WHEN pm2.PROJ_ROLE = 'MANAGER' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CASE WHEN NVL(member_wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(member_wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u2.USER_NAME) ELSE u2.USER_NAME END ) FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm2 JOIN USERS u2 ON u2.USER_ID = pm2.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES member_wp ON member_wp.WS_ID = p.WS_ID AND member_wp.USER_ID = pm2.USER_ID WHERE pm2.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID ) AS "MEMBER_NAMES" FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.LEADER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES leader_wp ON leader_wp.WS_ID = p.WS_ID AND leader_wp.USER_ID = p.LEADER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJ_ID, MIN(START_DT) AS START_DT, MAX(END_DT) AS END_DT FROM EVENTS WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EVENT_TYPE = 'PROJECT_PERIOD' GROUP BY PROJ_ID ) pd ON pd.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 2 WHEN pd.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.END_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 3 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN (pd.START_DT IS NULL OR TRUNC(pd.START_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (pd.END_DT IS NULL OR TRUNC(pd.END_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE)) THEN pd.END_DT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN pd.START_DT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN pd.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.END_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN pd.END_DT END DESC NULLS LAST, p.PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "PROJ_ID", p.WS_ID AS "WS_ID", p.PROJ_NAME AS "PROJ_NAME", p.PROJ_DESC AS "PROJ_DESC", p.PROJ_TYPE AS "PROJ_TYPE", p.PROJ_CATEGORY AS "PROJ_CATEGORY", NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') AS "DELETE_STATUS", TO_CHAR(p.DELETE_DEADLINE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "DELETE_DEADLINE_DATE", NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) AS "PROJ_SCOPE", p.LEADER_ID AS "LEADER_ID", u.USER_NAME AS "LEADER_NAME", w.WS_NAME AS "WS_NAME", w.WS_IMAGE_PATH AS "WS_IMAGE_PATH", TO_CHAR(pd.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(pd.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN pd.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.END_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END AS "PROJECT_STATUS", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID) AS "MEMBER_COUNT", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT_TASKS t WHERE t.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID) AS "TASK_TOTAL", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT_TASKS t WHERE t.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID AND t.STATUS = 'DONE') AS "TASK_DONE", ( SELECT LISTAGG(u2.USER_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u2.USER_NAME) FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm2 JOIN USERS u2 ON u2.USER_ID = pm2.USER_ID WHERE pm2.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID ) AS "MEMBER_NAMES" FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.LEADER_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = p.WS_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJ_ID, MIN(START_DT) AS START_DT, MAX(END_DT) AS END_DT FROM EVENTS WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EVENT_TYPE = 'PROJECT_PERIOD' GROUP BY PROJ_ID ) pd ON pd.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) = 'PERSONAL' AND ( p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId} ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 2 WHEN pd.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.END_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 3 ELSE 1 END, NVL(pd.START_DT, SYSDATE) DESC, p.PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'TODO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TODO_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IN_PROGRESS_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DONE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS != 'DONE' AND END_AT IS NOT NULL AND END_AT < SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DELAYED_CNT FROM PROJECT_TASKS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT t.TASK_ID AS "TASK_ID", t.PROJ_ID AS "PROJ_ID", t.TITLE AS "TITLE", t.DESCRIPTION AS "DESCRIPTION", t.STATUS AS "STATUS", t.ASSIGNEE_ID AS "USER_ID", t.ASSIGNEE_ID AS "ASSIGNEE_ID", CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "USER_NAME", CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "ASSIGNEE_NAME", CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(wp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN wp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') = 'IMAGE' THEN u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE NULL END AS "PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH", pm.PROJ_ROLE AS "ASSIGNEE_ROLE", pm.PROJ_POSITION AS "ASSIGNEE_POSITION", t.ALL_DAY_YN AS "ALL_DAY_YN", t.CALENDAR_VISIBLE_YN AS "CALENDAR_VISIBLE_YN", NVL(t.RECORD_ENABLED_YN, 'N') AS "RECORD_ENABLED_YN", NVL(t.RECORD_VISIBILITY, 'PROJECT') AS "RECORD_VISIBILITY", CASE WHEN t.ALL_DAY_YN = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "USE_TIME", CASE WHEN t.ALL_DAY_YN = 'N' THEN TO_CHAR(t.START_AT, 'HH24:MI') END AS "START_TIME", CASE WHEN t.ALL_DAY_YN = 'N' THEN TO_CHAR(t.END_AT, 'HH24:MI') END AS "END_TIME", TO_CHAR(t.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(t.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", TO_CHAR(t.ACTUAL_STARTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "ACTUAL_START_DATE", TO_CHAR(t.COMPLETED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "ACTUAL_DONE_DATE", CASE WHEN t.STATUS != 'DONE' AND t.END_AT IS NOT NULL AND t.END_AT < SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "DELAYED_YN", t.SORT_ORDER AS "SORT_ORDER", 0 AS "PROGRESS" FROM PROJECT_TASKS t JOIN PROJECTS p ON p.PROJ_ID = t.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = t.ASSIGNEE_ID LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID = t.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID = t.ASSIGNEE_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES wp ON wp.WS_ID = p.WS_ID AND wp.USER_ID = t.ASSIGNEE_ID WHERE t.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY CASE t.STATUS WHEN 'TODO' THEN 1 WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2 WHEN 'DONE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'TODO' THEN t.START_AT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'TODO' THEN t.END_AT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN t.END_AT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN t.START_AT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN t.COMPLETED_AT END DESC NULLS LAST, t.TASK_ID DESC

SELECT t.TASK_ID AS "TASK_ID", t.TITLE AS "TITLE", t.STATUS AS "STATUS", TO_CHAR(t.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(t.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", CASE WHEN t.STATUS != 'DONE' AND t.END_AT IS NOT NULL AND t.END_AT < SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "DELAYED_YN", TO_CHAR(t.COMPLETED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "COMPLETED_DATE", t.SORT_ORDER AS "SORT_ORDER" FROM PROJECT_TASKS t WHERE t.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ( t.ASSIGNEE_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_TASK_ASSIGNEES pta WHERE pta.TASK_ID = t.TASK_ID AND pta.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.STATUS != 'DONE' AND t.END_AT IS NOT NULL AND t.END_AT < SYSDATE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE t.STATUS WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'TODO' THEN 2 WHEN 'DONE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CASE WHEN t.STATUS != 'DONE' THEN t.END_AT END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN t.COMPLETED_AT END DESC NULLS LAST, t.TASK_ID DESC

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTES n WHERE n.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND n.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND n.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND ( NOT secret_marker.TARGET_ID = secret_marker.OWNER_ID AND secret_marker.SHARED_BY = secret_marker.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(secret_marker.PERMISSION_TYPE, 'VIEW')) = 'VIEW' AND secret_marker.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE f.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PROJECT' AND f.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND f.CREATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND f.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES secret_marker WHERE secret_marker.CONTENT_TYPE = 'FILE' AND secret_marker.CONTENT_ID = f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AND secret_marker.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND secret_marker.TARGET_ID = secret_marker.OWNER_ID AND secret_marker.SHARED_BY = secret_marker.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(secret_marker.PERMISSION_TYPE, 'VIEW')) = 'VIEW' AND secret_marker.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(secret_marker.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' ) OR f.CREATED_BY = #{viewerUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES edit_share WHERE edit_share.CONTENT_TYPE = 'FILE' AND edit_share.CONTENT_ID = f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AND edit_share.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND edit_share.TARGET_ID = #{viewerUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND UPPER(NVL(edit_share.PERMISSION_TYPE, 'VIEW')) mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_SHARES ( SHARE_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT_ID, OWNER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PERMISSION_TYPE, SHARED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, ACTIVE_YN, SHARE_STATUS, RESPONDED_BY, RESPONDED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_CONTENT_SHARE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{planType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CASE #{planType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN 'PERIOD_PLAN' THEN (SELECT p.CREATED_BY FROM PROJECT_PERIOD_PLANS p WHERE p.PERIOD_PLAN_ID = #{planId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) WHEN 'TIME_PLAN' THEN (SELECT t.CREATED_BY FROM PROJECT_TIME_PLANS t WHERE t.TIME_PLAN_ID = #{planId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) WHEN 'WEEKLY_PLAN' THEN (SELECT w.CREATED_BY FROM PROJECT_WEEKLY_PLANS w WHERE w.WEEKLY_PLAN_ID = #{planId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) END, 'USER', #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'EDIT', #{grantedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, NULL, 'Y', 'ACCEPTED', #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
